sources.title: City of Chicago Personnel Rules
sources.governance_note: The Personnel Rules state that where they conflict with an applicable collective bargaining agreement, the CBA governs.
sources.represented_grievance_note: Personnel Rule XVI states that an employee covered by a grievance procedure negotiated through collective bargaining is not eligible to file a grievance under Rule XVI.
